verdict.rationale: Cerebras explicitly engineers for low TTFT (TCP-warming SDK feature, payload optimization/msgpack+gzip guidance) and high throughput (dedicated reserved-capacity endpoints, service tiers for priority processing, automatic prompt caching to raise effective throughput), and multiple independent hands-on reports corroborate extremely high tokens/sec (300+ tok/s draft model, beating 8x H100 clusters, 'needlessly fast' code generation). Missing for 10: independently published benchmark numbers/tables (vs anecdotal community claims) and no resolution of a cited rate-limit friction report that could affect sustained throughput for some users.
